result.abstractText: An Asia-enriched survey of 239 respondents found that reported implementation of spatial biology and three-dimensional pathology varied across self-rated experience groups. Respondents identified cost, analytical complexity, limited standardization, and insufficient interdisciplinary expertise as barriers, highlighting the needs for practical workflows and computational support.
